context_for_next_testing_agent: Granular permissions system fully tested. Key features: 1) Registration only allows Staff or Cadre role selection - other roles default to Staff. 2) New users created with is_approved=false and default permissions based on role. 3) Admin page All Users tab shows all 6 roles in dropdown (Commander, Finance, Plans & Programs, Executive Cadre, Staff, Cadre). 4) Unit dropdown shows Staff, Support Cadre, Exec Cadre, Ops Cadre, Squadron 1/2/3. 5) Inline permissions editor with 12 checkboxes (Dashboard, Roster View/Edit, Schedule View/Edit, Budget View/Edit, Analytics, Org Chart, Handbooks, Documents, Admin Panel). 6) Save Permissions and Reset to Role Defaults buttons. 7) POST /api/users/{id}/approve sends approval email (SendGrid API key not configured - warning logged but doesn't fail). 8) GET /api/profile returns user permissions. 9) One bug fixed: role validation in update_user_role endpoint.
